exposure: maternal age greater than or equal to 20 years
prenatal care provided in the private network
delivery in hospitals providing high complexity medical care
prenatal care with greater than or equal to 6 consultations
finding: Cesarean delivery rates were high in both public and private hospitals, but the rate in private hospitals was almost triple that of public hospitals, with no clear association between the studied variables and cesarean delivery in the private sector.
mod_finding: This study found high cesarean delivery rates in both public and private sectors in Brazil, with no association between studied variables and cesarean delivery in the private sector.
